item.title: How to manage errors in Vue apps
item.description: Managing errors in Vue applications ensures graceful handling of exceptions and provides better user experience during failures. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented error handling in production Vue applications. Vue provides global error handlers, lifecycle hooks, and patterns for catching and managing errors at different levels. This approach prevents application crashes and helps track errors for debugging and monitoring.
